text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... haah...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...... What a... rough and ferocious 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...It's dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It had so much presence, it felt like 
you'd be trampled underfoot. Truly like 
the pinnacle of the world.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If only I could just say right here and 
now that it was so amazing it moved me to 
tears, it'd be so much easier—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Sen... pai?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Why don't I want to just praise her 
honestly... Why do I feel so 
frustrated...?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Why...? Why do I want to win so badly...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: HEEEEEEEY YOUUUUUU!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why are you guys still standing there?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and get over here! You've always 
had the courage to duel and never give up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You've already fallen under my magic 
spell, haven't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then this time, make sure you entertain 
me!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Senpai, me too... kh. I feel the exact 
same way!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"My instincts, my heart won't stop 
pounding! That's why, that's why...!"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kawakami-san. ...Maybe I won't be 
able to clear this fence.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If I mess up, I might get hurt. Even so, 
regardless—

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Want to try flying?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Y-Yessir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two girls in the stands burst into a 
sprint. Pushing through the buzzing crowd, 
they carved their own path to the turf—
(Ksshhhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Haha, ahahaha! You're finally here. What 
took you two so long?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How was that? My racing magic cast its 
spell completely perfectly this time, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I got rushed. I rushed right into it.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I know just how strong you are, and not 
once have I ever beaten you in my head.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Logically speaking, I'm just a relic left 
behind. Even though I know I can't reach 
you anymore—

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, I'm frustrated, and I want to 
win! I want to run one more time!!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Me toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I wanna win tooooo, waaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Gross!? Kawakami, aren't you crying way 
too much!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-B-But...! I wanna do it toooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to give up on my dream 
either! I don't wanno give up firsd 
plaaace!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna give uuuup...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh, geez!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have something to do before 
crying? Come on now.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Where is my 'Thank you so much for the 
amazing magic, Lady Witch'?!"

Seeing her rivals leap past the 
grandstands and onto the turf, Sweep Tosho 
smiled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave it like this for a little 
while—... I made the request to the staff 
myself. Warm applause rippled through the 
venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And so, starting today, you guys are my 
disciples.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!? I am a princess, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"What about it? A princess always comes 
with a witch, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Plus, a great witch has gotta take on an 
apprentice! Just like Grandma did!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Um, does that mean we got dragged into 
Sweep's mess?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh~? You got a problem with that~!?
choice_data_list: (Well, I guess that could be the case...?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Becoming my apprentices has already been 
decided! And on top of that, I shall give 
you trials to become witches!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A trial?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the two of you will be challenging 
me at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You'd better show me in the race that my 
magic took hold properly!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You guys can do it! Do it! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...! Then I want to run the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, how cheeky of you to go picking the 
race yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Honestly... My familiar, I swear.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup! As your master, I'm going to totally 
wipe the floor with my disciple!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the witch moves on, taking a new 
step forward alongside her apprentice. The 
next goal is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
